name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 82 - Am 1
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 82 a. Calls for the full and urgent implementation of the Agreement establishing an interinstitutional body for ethical standards for members of institutions and advisory bodies referred to in Article 13 of the Treaty on European Union; commits to providing the necessary financial and human resources to allow the body to fulfil its mandate and implement its tasks properly;
